contexts.text: The elder shall serve the younger () = that the good of truth shall be lower for a time... than truth.
The affection of truth, and the derivative doctrine of truth, is what is called the younger son.
Not to give the younger (daughter) before the first-born () = that the affection of interior truth should (not) precede the affection of external truth. Explained.
I am less than all the mercies... Thou hast done to Thy servant () = humiliation in that state...
He was the younger () = (truth, Ephraim) which is in the second place.
If the house be too little for one of the flock () = if the particular good is not sufficient for innocence.
